label: H.R. 10522
title: Companion Animal Protection Against Cruel Testing Act

items.snippet: This bill prohibits the use of funds made available to covered federal agencies for any biomedical research activity involving a live dog or cat.

items.item: Department of Health and Human Services (HHS)
items.snippet: Covered agencies are agencies or offices within the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) that award, administer, or expend federal funds for biomedical research.
Finally, the Government Accountability Office must report to Congress on the bill's implementation within three years after the bill takes effect.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
lobbying.amount_note: Amounts are the income or expenses reported on the whole LD-2 filing, not money spent on this bill.

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.

L000600.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
L000600.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
